    def test_update(sheet_name, test_name, prompt, section_name, entry_name, evaluation_metrice, client, generate, ragmetric, evaluation_model, view_helpers_factory):
        import io, sys, datetime
        allure.dynamic.parent_suite(sheet_name)
        allure.dynamic.suite("edit")
        allure.dynamic.sub_suite(test_name)
        # Attach execution time
        exec_time = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        allure.attach(exec_time, name="Execution Time", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
        # Capture stdout
        stdout_capture = io.StringIO()
        old_stdout = sys.stdout
        sys.stdout = stdout_capture
        try:
            # Load section and item descriptions from Excel
            try:
                sections_data = load_sections()
            except Exception:
                sections_data = []
            section_desc = None
            for s in sections_data:
                if s.get('SECTION_NAME') == section_name:
                    section_desc = s.get('SECTION_DESC')
                    break
    
            try:
                entries_data = load_entries()
            except Exception:
                entries_data = []
            item_desc = None
            for e in entries_data:
                if e.get('ENTRY_NAME') == entry_name:
                    item_desc = e.get('ITEM_DESC')
                    break
    
            value = client.get_config_entry_with_mapped_section(section_name, entry_name, generate_llm=generate)
            allure.attach(str(value), name="Original Config Value", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            prompt = generate.update_query(section_name=section_name, entry_name=entry_name, section_desc=section_desc or "", item_desc=item_desc or "")
            expected_response = generate.update_confirmation(section_name=section_name, entry_name=entry_name, update_query=prompt, section_desc=section_desc or "", item_desc=item_desc or "")
            session_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    
            # Initialize helpers for metadata validation via fixture
            helpers = view_helpers_factory(session_id, section_name, entry_name, section_desc or "", item_desc or "")
    
            ask_result = client.ask(session_id=session_id, user_query=prompt)
            text_response = ask_result["text_response"]
            metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            latency = ask_result.get("latency")
            allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            if metadata and metadata.get("type") in ["success"]:
                allure.attach(str(latency), name="Latency", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(prompt), name="Prompt", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(expected_response), name="Expected Response", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(text_response), name="LLM Response", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
                # Validate and restore metadata if validation fails
                helpers.validate_metadata_and_restore_db(metadata, user_type="Admin")
    
                updated_value = client.get_config_entry_with_mapped_section(section_name, entry_name, generate_llm=generate)
                allure.attach(str(updated_value), name="Updated Config Value", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                restore_success = client.update_config_entry_value(value)
                allure.attach(str(restore_success), name="Restored DB value to original", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert client.verify_update_with_prompt(updated_value, prompt), (
                    f"DB value does not match intended value after update.\nPrompt: {prompt}\nDB Value: {updated_value}")
                metric = ragmetric("answer_correctness")
                test_case = LLMTestCase(
                    input=prompt,
                    actual_output=text_response,
                    expected_output=expected_response
                )
                metric.measure(test_case)
                allure.attach(str(metric.score), name="Score", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(metric.reason), name="Reason", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert metric.is_successful(), f"Failed: {metric.reason}"
            elif metadata and metadata.get("type") == "error":
                allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
